profile.headline: CNC Programmer (3/4/5-axis Mastercam) & Software Developer | C#/.NET | Building an ERP for CNC machine shops | Founder @ MK Programming Services LLC
profile.summary:
I work on both sides of manufacturing: 13 years programming CNC parts, and now building the software that machine shops run on.

By day I program 3-, 4-, and 5-axis milling in Mastercam — aerospace and precision parts in titanium, stainless, and aluminum — delivered remotely through my company, MK Programming Services LLC (remotecncprogramming.com).

On the software side, I build the tools I always wished existed on the shop floor:

• A complete ERP / shop-management system for CNC job shops — quoting and RFQs, job travelers, scheduling, shop-floor time tracking, payroll, purchasing, and AS9100 quality records (NCR, CAPA, FAI, internal audits). C#/.NET 8, Blazor web app, WPF desktop client, EF Core/SQLite — deployed on-premises and used in daily production.
• An embedded, fully local AI assistant inside that ERP (GPU-accelerated LLM engine), plus AI-assisted job intake that turns customer POs and drawings into draft jobs.
• Mastercam add-ins in C#/.NET (NET-Hook API): toolpath automation, cross-version operation transfer, AI-assisted machining planning, and a SQLite knowledge base that recommends proven speeds and feeds from real cut data.
• A remote-desktop application (.NET 8) I use every day to support shops remotely.

The point of all of it: software written by someone who has actually run the parts — quoting, travelers, and toolpaths the way a working shop needs them.

Open to freelance and contract work — CNC programming or manufacturing software. Not looking for full-time roles.

hieu.nguyenmfg@gmail.com · remotecncprogramming.com

positions.title: Founder | CNC Programmer & Software Developer
positions.description:
Independent CNC programming and manufacturing-software practice serving US machine shops (remotecncprogramming.com).

CNC Programming
• Remote Mastercam programming for 3-, 4-, and 5-axis milling — aerospace and precision parts in titanium, stainless, and aluminum.
• Deliver proven-out posted programs with full setup documentation: setup sheets, tool lists, and stock models.

Software Development
• Designing and building a full ERP / shop-management system for CNC job shops — RFQs and quoting, job travelers, scheduling, shop-floor time tracking, payroll, purchasing, and AS9100 quality records (NCR, CAPA, FAI, internal audits). C#/.NET 8, Blazor web app, WPF desktop client, EF Core/SQLite; deployed on-premises and in daily production use on a real shop floor.
• Integrated an embedded, fully local AI assistant into the ERP (GPU-accelerated LLM engine) plus AI-assisted job intake that reads customer POs and drawings into draft jobs.
• Develop Mastercam add-ins in C#/.NET (NET-Hook API): toolpath automation, cross-version operation import/export bridges, AI-assisted machining planning, and a SQLite knowledge base that recommends proven speeds and feeds from real shop data.
• Built and shipped a remote-desktop application (.NET 8, Host + Viewer) used daily for remote machine-shop support.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · SQL · Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) · Blazor · .NET Framework

positions.title: CNC Programmer
positions.description:
Programming: 
•	Responsible for programming 3-axis, 4-axis and 5-axis Tilt Rotary of Mori Seiki Dura Vertical 5100 (Mill), 3-axis and 4-axis of FADAL (Mill) machines and 2-axis lathe with Funuc and Mitsubishi controls by using MasterCAM 2017.
•	Create working CAD model from blueprints or from customer supplied date files by using Solidworks or MasterCAM.
•	Maintained all CNC programs and ensured accuracy of all instructions through comparison with original blueprints.
•	Analyzed and recommended all cutting tools with the proper speed and feeds for CNC programs.
•	Responsible for machining and operating titanium, stainless steel and aluminum material.
•	Designed and fabricated tooling and fixtures due to machining requirements.
•	Provided planning sequence sheets, set-up sheets and instructions to machinists by using Solidworks.
•	Responsible with close tolerance +/- .0002.
•	Participated in brainstorming/problem solving with engineering and production personnel to solve related problems.
Planning:
•	Use M1 (ERP system) to define production sequences/operations.
•	Estimate runtime for each production operation.
•	Defined required raw material (size, blocks quantities, Alloy type).
•	Defined special tool cutters to be able to manufacture parts.
•	Create Job traveler.
•	Determine required plating, anodize or nickel plate or fusion bonded epoxy coating.
